ns0:g.ns0:text: Batch reaction time integrates the reciprocal rate from the initial state to target conversion
Well-mixed, isothermal, irreversible first-order reaction at constant volume. Reaction time excludes charge, heat-up, discharge and cleaning. The
reciprocal-rate integral must use the actual kinetics along the trajectory; an outlet-rate rectangle would be a CSTR relation, not this batch design.
